# Cairn

> Cairn turns a rough product idea into a clear product brief, user flow, builder pack, and reality check.

## Product

Cairn is a mobile first web app designed for the Nimiq Pay mini app environment. A person describes an idea in plain language. Cairn returns an editable brief, a five to eight step user flow with one decision point, practical milestones and tasks, acceptance tests, and a reality check.

## Privacy

Saved plans stay in browser local storage until the person chooses to share. Generation sends the submitted description through Cairn's server to Google Gemini. Cairn does not require an account and does not run Google Analytics or advertising tracking.

## Payment

New wallets receive a small free allowance. Extra planner actions are purchased as a bundle with NIM through Nimiq Pay. Cairn does not custody user funds.
